// diagnostic

E0956

`{what_text}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

What

`{what_text}` isn't supported by the current evaluator yet

Why

The canonical evaluator doesn't cover this construct yet

Fix

Report this unsupported construct as a compiler bug

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0956: tests/ui/compiler_api/compiler_query_phase_boundary_is_preserved_for_aliases.stderr.

Error [jet.ComptimeConstructNotSupported]: `core.compiler.lex` is compile-time only
  --> tests/ui/compiler_api/compiler_query_phase_boundary_is_preserved_for_aliases.jet:2:22
    |
  2 | run: fn() { compiler.lex(`run: fn() {}`) }
    |                      ^^^
 Why: The compiler API exposes read-only front-end facts to build and comptime code; it is not a runtime service
 Fix: Move this call into `build: fn` or a `comptime` binding
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0956

Error [jet.MissingErrorConversion]: This implicit fallible call can't convert `CompilerError` into `Err` — no declared conversion exists
  --> tests/ui/compiler_api/compiler_query_phase_boundary_is_preserved_for_aliases.jet:2:22
    |
  2 | run: fn() { compiler.lex(`run: fn() {}`) }
    |                      ^^^
 Why: Ordinary fallible calls propagate automatically; `CompilerError` can reach `Err` only through `impl CompilerError -> Err`
 Fix: Handle this call locally with `??`, add `impl CompilerError -> Err { … }`, or change the return type
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E2402
